description: This file defines API route handlers for an Event Booking System using FastAPI. It includes endpoints for user authentication, event CRUD operations, booking management, admin analytics, and notification webhooks.

methods.name: get_current_user
methods.description: Extracts the current user from a JWT token provided in the query parameter.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates a new user, and sends a welcome email.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT access token.

methods.name: create_event
methods.description: Creates a new event, only accessible by organizers or admins.

methods.name: list_events
methods.description: Lists or searches events with optional filtering.

methods.name: get_event
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific event by ID.

methods.name: edit_event
methods.description: Edits an existing event, accessible by admins or the event organizer.

methods.name: delete_event
methods.description: Deletes an event, accessible by admins or the event organizer.

methods.name: book_event
methods.description: Books tickets for an event, decreasing available seats.

methods.name: pay_booking
methods.description: Mocks payment for a booking and confirms it, sending a confirmation email.

methods.name: my_bookings
methods.description: Lists bookings made by the current user.

methods.name: admin_events
methods.description: Lists all events for admin moderation.

methods.name: admin_analytics
methods.description: Provides simple metrics for admin overview.

methods.name: webhook_email
methods.description: Stub endpoint to trigger email notifications.
